q: Arrange in order of wavelength from the longest to the shortest: visible light, radio waves, X-rays and infrared radiation.
a: Radio waves, infrared radiation, visible light, X-rays. The frequency increases in the same order, because $c = f\lambda$ is the same for all.

q: The absolute temperature of a black body triples. How does the wavelength of the peak of its spectrum change?
a: It decreases to a third, because $\lambda_\text{max} T = b$ is constant: the wavelength of the peak is inversely proportional to the absolute temperature.
